subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When status is requested, the system shall derive open draft proposals, remote lock versions, and document-pipeline ledgers for the selected host without another host's CLI.
fit_criterion: Forgejo fixtures cover no contract, new draft, locked version, reopened draft with the previous version still binding, and an unmigrated document-pipeline feature with zero gh calls; absent or ambiguous proposal state is named.
